title: nengella minor
intro: Nengella minor, commonly known as the 'Cassowary Plum', is a plant species native to tropical regions of Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nengella minor include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
